CustomField.formula: If( (DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)>DATE(2025,12,26) && DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)<DATE(2026,01,03)), 53, IF(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))>=2026, MOD(FLOOR( (DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) - DATEVALUE("2026-01-03")) /7),52)+1, IF(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))<=2020, MIN(CEILING(((DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) - DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 1, 1) + 1) + MOD(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 1, 1) - DATE(2012, 1, 7), 7)) / 7),52), MOD(FLOOR( (DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) - DATEVALUE("2021-01-02")) /7),52)+1 ) ) )
